rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for bathing using a shower.

example.english: I shower as soon as I get home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 cung1 loeng4

rows.note: Use this formal term in contexts describing bathing under a shower, especially in writing or official language.

example.english: Please shower before entering the swimming pool.
example.jyutping: zeon3 jap6 wing6 ci4 cin4 ceng2 sin1 lam4 juk6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday rendering for the act of taking a shower.

example.english: I'll take a shower first and reply to you later.
example.jyutping: ngo5 cung1 loeng4 sin1 zan6 gaan1 zoi3 fuk1 nei5

rows.note: Use this formal noun for shower equipment or showering in technical or written contexts.

example.english: This hotel’s shower equipment is well-equipped.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店嘅淋浴設備好齊全。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 lam4 juk6 cit3 bei6 hou2 cai4 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for the physical shower fixture rather than the act of bathing.

example.english: The shower is broken, so we need to replace it with a new one.
example.jyutping: faa1 saa2 waai6 zo2 jiu3 wun6 go3 san1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a brief spell of rain in a weather forecast or description.

example.english: The weather forecast says there will be a shower tomorrow.
example.traditional: 聽日天氣預報話有陣雨。
example.jyutping: teng1 jat6 tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 jau5 zan6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this when someone gives gifts or other things very generously and abundantly.

example.english: The mall will shower customers with gifts in this promotion.
example.traditional: 今次商場做大抽獎，狂送禮物畀客人。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 soeng1 coeng4 zou6 daai6 cau1 zoeng2 kwong4 sung3 lai5 mat6 bei2 haak3 jan4
